message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The current best trade-off is the phase_bits=14 LUT (SQNR 72.8 dB, area 1346 um^2), which dominates the phase_bits=12 point (61 dB) and the CORDIC point (70.8 dB at 2837 um^2). Decreasing precision is the only legal action that can move toward a smaller-area neighbor while retaining acceptable numerical quality, and it has 2 unvisited neighbors to explore."}
